name: Punarnava
kitchenUse: The leaves are cooked as a green in some regions; as a remedy it is taken as powder or decoction.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: Swelling of the legs or face needs a doctor to find the cause first.

cautions.note: Not enough is known; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
Swelling can be a sign of kidney or heart disease; see a doctor rather than treating it at home.
Do not use for swelling from heart failure without your doctor.

interactions.effect: May add to the effect of water pills.
Diuretic herbs can raise lithium to harmful levels.

evidence.summary: Mostly laboratory and animal studies; little research in people.
